programs.7_diagnostics_causal_meta: Select unsupervised distributional reliability of the existing original signal inputs. Learn the per-component density of the original dimensionless feature from recorded computed decisions, with no trade-return, account reward, treatment or future-price target. Compare fixed density and strictly delayed own-observation online density as gates on otherwise-original passed signals. This uses input likelihood, not an expected-profit or intervention-effect estimate.

distinctness: The learned object is the probability density of a contemporaneously observed original feature, with self-supervision supplied by that feature itself after its original decision row is complete. Previous Family1 learned accepted-trade stressedR and changed size/stop; Family16 learned randomized future account treatment effect; Family18 changed three strategy variance denominators. This proposal does none of those. All six original algebra/thresholds/directions and capital/SL/exit laws stay unchanged; only new-entry abstention on a predeclared low-density observation is tested. No old model, reward, trajectory, scalar parameter or source implementation is reused.
